tester: Codex automated checks on the existing development Windows machine
limitations: Existing Windows 11 machine only; clean Windows without codec packs and real installer install/update/uninstall have not been validated.
Registration-free COM and isolated registry/installer-init regressions passed; visible Explorer thumbnails, surrogate activation and default-app coexistence remain untested.
Physical HDR10, HDR toggling, monitor transitions and reference SDR color correctness are untested. A synthetic PQ/BT.2020 thumbnail exercised tone mapping only.
The sample suite does not establish the full codec matrix: VC-1, 4K/8K, long paths, variable frame rate and every GPU/software fallback combination remain untested.
Subtitle stream loading/selection and audio switching passed; visual ASS/SSA styling, GUI external subtitle loading and the complete resume workflow still need manual acceptance.
Performance is seven warm-cache trials on one machine and one 1080p H.264/AAC fixture. Window handles and playback position notifications are not first-rendered-frame measurements.

The bundled auxiliary FFmpeg CLI has a Unicode argv limitation; four original CLI failures are retained in the media report. Supplementary decode used verified byte-identical ASCII hardlinks. Native playback and COM used original Turkish paths successfully.

quality.installerInitialization: native/machine/user accepted; redirected path rejected; no actual installation
quality.knownCredentialAndPrivateFileScan: pass for tracked files and public Git history

media.nativePlayback: 23 playable samples, external SRT/ASS/VTT, embedded subtitles, alternate audio track and playback controls
media.thumbnails: H.264, HEVC 10-bit and AV1 10-bit produce opaque colored BGRA bitmaps; invalid input rejected; stalled worker terminated

hdrThumbnail.scope: Synthetic PQ/BT.2020 HEVC thumbnail path, not physical HDR/color acceptance

media.abi: Twelve FFmpeg 8 x64 C header offsets checked with compiled C probe and matched Rust ABI assertions
